AssistantProfile.description: The console's assistant identity and output preferences.
AssistantProfile.title: AssistantProfile

Board.description: The complete board; the layer remembers it once a presenter shows an item.
Board.title: Board

BoardReceipt.description: A presenter rendered one board item; only shown items become context.
BoardReceipt.title: BoardReceipt

ErrorBody.description: The JSON body of every non-2xx response; ``detail`` is shown to operators.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

FragmentReviewContext.description: What the layer needs to review one answer's fragments; the core echoes it back.
FragmentReviewContext.title: FragmentReviewContext

GpuOffload.description: Whether the owned llama-server runs every layer on the GPU; ``known`` false before one ran.
GpuOffload.title: GpuOffload

GreetingReceipt.description: The greeting actually played; a later question may refer to it.
GreetingReceipt.title: GreetingReceipt

HandoffDecision.description: ``target`` is a candidate id, or ``None`` to ask the visitor first.
HandoffDecision.title: HandoffDecision

LlmEngineSettings.description:
``PUT /engine``: the console switched the published model or persona.

Live conversations that are not snapshots follow it; unset fields keep
their values.
LlmEngineSettings.title: LlmEngineSettings

LlmSession.description: One conversation as its requests name it; memory is keyed by these ids.
LlmSession.title: LlmSession

LlmSettings.description: The answer model one request uses: an allowlisted endpoint and its options.
LlmSettings.title: LlmSettings

LocalServerSettings.description: An owned llama-server: a GGUF name from the model list, served on loopback.
LocalServerSettings.title: LocalServerSettings

ModelChunk.description: The model produced chunk ``llm_sequence``; the core may cancel before it is used.
ModelChunk.title: ModelChunk

Outcome.description: Whether the operation found something to change.
Outcome.title: Outcome

Question.title: Question

RagFlowDocuments.description: One page of a dataset's documents, as RAGFlow's console listing shows it.
RagFlowDocuments.title: RagFlowDocuments

ReplyDone.description: The last event. The core's reviewed speech wins over ``spoken`` when there is any.
ReplyDone.title: ReplyDone

ReplyRules.description: One published version of the editable reply rules; the core validated it.
ReplyRules.title: ReplyRules

ReplyStarted.description: The first event: the turn's id and how its fragments must be reviewed.
ReplyStarted.title: ReplyStarted

ReviewState.description: One answer's review so far; the core keeps it and sends it with the next fragment.
ReviewState.title: ReviewState

ReviewedFragment.description: A playable fragment the LLM accepted, with its live-transcript increment.
ReviewedFragment.title: ReviewedFragment

RoleCandidate.description: One role that may answer a turn, as the core's role composition defines it.
RoleCandidate.title: RoleCandidate

SessionRecords.description: Whether any role of the conversation remembers a message or a board.
SessionRecords.title: SessionRecords

SessionRef.description:
A conversation, and optionally one role's memory in it.

``profile_id`` ``None`` means the role currently selected (or, for
clearing, every role); ``""`` is a conversation without roles.
SessionRef.title: SessionRef

SpeechEnd.description: The spoken section is complete: a boundary even without punctuation.
SpeechEnd.title: SpeechEnd

SpokenDelta.description: A spoken-text increment from one model chunk; not a playable fragment.
SpokenDelta.title: SpokenDelta

SpokenTurn.description: A fixed reply (handoff announcement, failure) enters history when played.
SpokenTurn.title: SpokenTurn

WeatherReport.description: CWA facts for one accepted place and date range, as the console shows them.
WeatherReport.title: WeatherReport

WebEvidence.description: Public web references this answer must rely on.
WebEvidence.title: WebEvidence

WebEvidenceSelection.description: The verified quotes chosen from a search; ``unavailable`` when none could be.
WebEvidenceSelection.title: WebEvidenceSelection
